name: Passport Photo Maker configures country standards and printable sheet layouts
description: Verifies the passport photo tool provides standard country dimension presets, background replacement options, and print sheet configuration.

planSteps.description: Verify the photo maker upload area and country preset selector are visible
Click on the country preset selector and choose 'Schengen / EU (35x45 mm)'
Verify the dimensions indicator updates to 35 x 45 mm
Click the 'Light Blue' background color option
Verify the background color selection is updated
Verify the 4x6 inch printable sheet toggle option is available
